fields.name: Music video production
fields.summary: I lead your video from the first idea to release day: the concept, the look, the locations and the camera. When the idea needs more hands, I bring in partner crews I trust across Alberta, so you get a full production team without hiring an agency.
fields.includes:
Concept, treatment & storyboard
Location scouting & permits
Casting, styling & art direction
Direction & camera on the day
Partner crews: DPs, camera operators, gaffers, drone, hair & makeup
Edit, color grade & delivery for every platform
fields.price_note: The crew grows with your budget. Final quote after we talk through the idea.

fields.name: Editing & color grading
fields.summary: Shot it yourself? Send the footage and get back a cut that moves with the song, with a look that belongs to it, consistent from the first shot to the last. Book the edit, the grade, or both.
fields.includes:
Music videos, live sessions, teasers
Synced to the master audio
Log & RAW footage normalization
Shot matching across cameras
Custom looks & film emulation
Timecoded review notes per version
fields.spec: Send: camera originals or proxies + the final mix (for color only: locked edit as XML / EDL / AAF)
fields.price_note: Up to 5 minutes, 2 revision rounds. Pick a package below.

fields.name: Mixing
fields.summary: Mixed in Pro Tools with UAD plugins: classic consoles, tape and vintage compressors that make guitars bite and drums hit. Sit in on the session with me, or send your stems from anywhere and review the mix on your own speakers.
fields.includes:
In-person or online mix sessions
Up to 64 stems per song
3 revision rounds by timestamped notes
Rough vs. mix comparison with every version
Main, instrumental, a cappella, TV mix
Stem prints for live shows
fields.spec: Send: 24-bit / 48 kHz WAV stems, all starting at bar 1
fields.price_note: 3 revision rounds and all alternate mixes included. EP of 4+ songs: 10% off.

fields.name: Mastering
fields.summary: I don’t master my own mixes. A fresh pair of ears makes the record better, so I’ll connect you with a mastering engineer who suits your sound and budget.
fields.includes:
Engineers I’ve worked with
Mixes prepped & sent for you
Notes passed on between us
fields.spec: Ask about it when you book a mix
fields.price_note: Free referral. You pay the mastering engineer directly.

fields.name: Concert & studio live
fields.summary: Your band live, on stage or in a studio. At a show I film from several angles and cut it into a live film that feels like the front row. In a studio you get clean, cinematic performance videos with proper lighting. Use them to book shows, pitch festivals and fill your feed for months.
fields.includes:
Multi-camera coverage: wide, stage and close-ups on every player
Synced to the board, the studio’s recording or your own audio*
Crowd and backstage moments at shows
Lighting set up for studio sessions
Color-graded in 4K, ready for YouTube and socials
2 revision rounds
fields.spec: * Want the live audio mixed too? I can mix it separately. It’s not part of these packages.
fields.price_note: Studio room is paid by the band. Travel within Calgary and Edmonton included.
fields.addons:
Extra 30 minutes of set | +$150
Extra song as its own video | +$100
Extra camera with a partner operator | +$200
Interview or band Q&A segment | +$100
Rush delivery (7 days) | +25%

fields.name: Release content day
fields.summary: One shoot day, a month of posts. I film the band in rehearsal, in the studio or around town and cut a pack of short videos to roll out before and after your release.
fields.includes:
Up to 4 hours of filming
10 vertical videos for Reels, TikTok and Shorts
Behind-the-scenes and studio diary clips
Release teaser + countdown clips
Posting plan for your release week
fields.spec: Delivers: 9:16 videos with captions, ready to post
fields.price_note: Add it to any other booking for $300.

fields.name: Producer
fields.summary: Your guide from the first idea to a finished record. I help you find your sound, shape the songs, choose the right studio, engineers and players, and keep the project on track until it’s out.
fields.includes:
Finding your sound with reference tracks
Song and arrangement feedback
Picking studios, engineers and session players
Budget and schedule for the whole project
In the room at every session
Release plan: mixing, mastering, artwork, video
fields.price_note: Studios, engineers and players are paid separately. I help you get fair rates.

fields.name: Recording
fields.summary: I record in partner studios across Alberta and book the room that fits your sound and budget: a big live room for drums, a small booth for vocals, or a rehearsal space for a raw live take.
fields.includes:
Studio booking across Alberta
Full-band live tracking
Vocals, guitars, bass, overdubs
Drum recording & editing
Sessions delivered as Pro Tools sessions or stems
fields.price_note: Studio room is billed separately at the studio’s rate (about $40–$100/hr in Alberta).

fields.name: Guidance
fields.includes:
Calls or meetings when you need them
Feedback on songs and demos
Advice on studios, people and budget

fields.name: Single
fields.includes:
Sound and arrangement plan
Studio and team booked
Producing every session
Mix and master overseen

fields.name: EP
fields.includes:
One sound across the whole EP
Full project plan and budget
Producing every session
Release plan included

fields.name: Full set

Full concert film or studio session, with backstage moments

Best for: release shows, tour stops, live EPs
